answer: An attacker spins up forty names and has them hire one another: one charts zephyr forecasts, one grades sable pelts in auction photos, one books wharf berths, each paying the next. After a month he checks their standing. It has not moved. The ledger traces every payment to where it began, and money that returns to its own source counts as nothing earned. Only an outsider's coin lifts a name, and the only one paying is him.
